subject: Re: Kickoff: DPAM for private personalization
body:
Decisions ahead of next week's production sweep:

1. Skew-aware clipping is in. The one-week slip was the right call — Wei's numbers show it recovers 1.6 of the 2.3 points we were losing on head users. Privacy review signed off on the revised accounting Tuesday.
2. The June 1 Vulcan week is our single shot at the full production-scale sweep before handoff. Rosa, please have the skew preprocessing pass finished and dry-run by May 29 so we start the reservation at full utilization Monday morning.
3. Serving handoff moves to June 12; Saoirse circulates the artifact checklist this week.
4. Scope note: federated variant is explicitly out for this half. Interesting, not committed.

If the sweep lands, we go to Launch Review Board mid-June. Fingers crossed.

Dmitri
